description: This file defines the SaveQualificationLicenseController class, which manages the pre-render logic for licensing-related views within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and conditionally sets up Vue components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the Vue component for license editing or creation, based on the request attribute 'id'.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component ('license-edit' or 'license-save') based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
